arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math

# Values in millions of dollars
commercial_banks = 77688
mutual_savings_banks = 4206

# Calculate ratio
ratio = commercial_banks / mutual_savings_banks
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')

# Calculate natural logarithm
ln_ratio = math.log(ratio)
print(f'Natural log of ratio: {ln_ratio}')

# Round to nearest thousandths
rounded = round(ln_ratio, 3)
print(f'Rounded to nearest thousandths: {rounded}')
"
